column1: # [waw-decomp] 2026-11-16 discmap: the builds of Call of Duty 3's programs it knows, by the SHA-1 of the
# decrypted image (the same program on two discs is one build). Data, not code: a new build is added here
# once its map is reviewed. From rc-discs' disc_programs.tsv (2026-11-16, read off the four discs).
# status: reference (the build the sources are written for) | mapped (addresses carried from `reference`)
# export: a Ghidra export (WawExport.java) of the program, relative to the project, when there is one
# sha1_raw: the XEX files' own SHA-1s seen for this image (a disc's file differs; its image doesn't)

column9: USA/Europe disc; the German and Fr/Es/It campaigns are this build
German disc: a rebuild of usa_mp (the same functions, some moved or changed)
French/Spanish/Italian disc: a rebuild of usa_mp
Japanese disc: a later build, level DLLs too
